title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Periods and Deadlines Table
content:
## Periods and deadlines (calendar days, identical on every tier)

| Period | Meaning | Days |
|---|---|---|
| Application period | days from an encounter's first post-discharge billing statement within which an application for that encounter is accepted and processed | 240 |
| Notification period | days from the first post-discharge billing statement during which no extraordinary collection action may begin | 120 |
| Missing-information response | days after the missing-information notice the patient has to supply the missing documents | 30 |
| Determination | days after an application is complete within which Riverbend issues the determination letter | 30 |
| Reconsideration request | days after the denial letter within which the patient may request reconsideration with new information | 30 |
| Reapplication wait | days after an income-based denial before a new application without a change in circumstances is accepted | 90 |
| BadgerCare Plus screening deadline | days after the screening referral to provide the BadgerCare Plus determination | 45 |

Tiers: Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care; Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL); Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL); Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL); Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL); Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL).

### Reading the table

All figures are calendar days. The application and notification periods both run from the same anchor, the encounter's first post-discharge billing statement; the application period (240 days) is twice the notification period (120 days).
